content.title: Why Is Coherent (COHR) Stock Rocketing Higher Today
content.summary: Shares of materials and photonics company Coherent (NYSE:COHR) jumped 10.8% in the afternoon session after the company announced the launch of its Sapphire XT, a new compact and powerful visible laser platform. Based on its proven Optically Pumped Semiconductor (OPS) technology, the new product doubled the performance of prior models while cutting its size by more than 50%. The Sapphire XT was released as a one-box system with an integrated controller and a footprint comparable to a smartphone.
